standards.name: Marine Community Profile (MCP) v2.0
standards.abstract: The Marine Community Profile (MCP) v2.0 is an XML profile of the ISO 19115 geographic metadata standard implemented using ISO 19139, intended to describe marine geographic datasets. It is used to record metadata about marine datasets (spatial extents, temporal coverage, taxonomic coverage, licensing, data parameters, sampling frequency, etc.) and is typically implemented within catalog software such as GeoNetwork. The MCP is maintained by the MCP Governance Committee and was developed by Australian marine data stakeholders (AODCJF, BlueNet, AODN, IMOS and others) to address gaps in ISO19115 for marine datasets by adding concrete XML elements, data dictionaries, and controlled vocabularies for common marine metadata needs.

classification.rationale: The source document contains explicit data dictionaries and tabular listings of named metadata elements with XPaths and data types (e.g. 'Mandatory Metadata Elements' table, 'Data Dictionary' tables for extensions such as DataParameters and MD_Commons). These are field-level definitions (name + concrete type/format) rather than prose guidance, so the source is best represented as a table.
